method: Independent ASR of delivered MP3s, no authored-text prompt; punctuation/case/apostrophe and 20-to-twenty normalization only. Automated proxy, not human listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: Before you carry another part of me out of this room, tell me what happened to the first one.
lines.transcription: Before you carry another part of me out of this room, tell me what happened to the first one.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: He paid you for it. I thought hearing you say it would feel different.
lines.transcription: He paid you for it. I thought hearing you say it would feel different.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: So it went to him and to the street. When do I get to be more than the voice they pass around?
lines.transcription: So it went to him and to the street. When do I get to be more than the voice they pass around?

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: I never asked you to choose what was worth keeping. I know why you might have.
lines.transcription: I never asked you to choose what was worth keeping. I know why you might have.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: He paid for what was left. I wonder which part of me he thought was the useful part.
lines.transcription: He paid for what was left. I wonder which part of me he thought was the useful part.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: You came back without it. That doesn't tell me what was left in the chair.
lines.transcription: You came back without it. That doesn't tell me what was left in the chair.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: You stayed in that sentence. Thank you. It is harder to talk to someone who keeps disappearing behind the job.
lines.transcription: You stayed in that sentence. Thank you. It is harder to talk to someone who keeps disappearing behind the job.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: Quill is not sitting here. You are. We can finish the letter. Leave the rest for today.
lines.transcription: Quill is not sitting here. You are. We can finish the letter. Leave the rest for today.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: Then carry only what we agreed. You don't owe me your reasons, and I don't owe you a softer version of mine.
lines.transcription: Then carry only what we agreed. You don't owe me your reasons, and I don't owe you a softer version of mine.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: I remember where you put yourself in the story. You can sit without explaining it again.
lines.transcription: I remember where you put yourself in the story. You can sit without explaining it again.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: Last time, you told me whose job it was. You never told me where you stood.
lines.transcription: Last time, you told me whose job it was. You never told me where you stood.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: We left that conversation where we meant to. I haven't filled the silence in for you.
lines.transcription: We left that conversation where we meant to. I haven't filled the silence in for you.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: You told me where the hour went. We stopped before the rest. We can leave it there.
lines.transcription: You told me where the hour went. We stopped before the rest. We can leave it there.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: A morning market. I used to go before the stalls opened, when nobody wanted anything from me yet. I would like to choose that again.
lines.transcription: A morning market. I used to go before the stalls opened, when nobody wanted anything from me yet. I would like to choose that again.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.authoredText: I hear the difference. Let it stay different. I don't want to do the rest of this conversation today.
lines.transcription: I hear the difference. Let it stay different. I don't want to do the rest of this conversation today.
